caption:
the day I stopped punishing myself for a bad night

#recovery #routine #wellness

slides.text:
I slept five hours

My app cancelled
my workout

It saw the night
before I opened my eyes

Old me: coffee, pre-workout,
push through it

And a flat week after

Today: a twenty-minute walk
instead of a heavy session

More food, earlier night

The plan moved
and the week survived

slides.heading: A bad night is data, not a failure
slides.body: SOMA reads how you actually slept and rebuilds the day around it — pushing when you can, backing off when you can't
